7.6. Volume Rendering The following diagrams and video illustrate the basic concept of volume rendering. Fig. 7.4 Volume Rendering in medical imaging, is implemented via Ray Casting. Imagine the reverse of a pinhole camera model. For each image pixel, project a ray into space, and evaluate the voxel intensity values along each step through the volume. See video.
